title: Omugugu gw’Obugagga
intro: Oyimiridde mu maaso g’olugero olw’omukisa omungi ennyo, obulamu obuyooyooteddwa zaabu n’amaanyi, naye ku nkomerero ng’essomo ery’okwegendereza eri bonna abanoonya obukulu obw’ensi. Osobola okuzuula omuntu ono emboozi ye ewulikika mu biseera, obujulizi ku butonde bw’ebintu eby’ensi obutakkaanya?
clues: Nali nva mu bantu ba Nabbi omukulu, naye nalonda ekkubo ery’amalala n’okunyigirizibwa.
Allah yampa obugagga bungi nnyo, ne kiba nti ebisumuluzo by’eby’obugagga byange byali bizito eri ekibinja ky’abasajja eky’amaanyi.
Abantu bange bampa amagezi obutasanyukira bugagga bwange, nga banzijukiza nti Allah tayagala basanyufu.
Nnagamba mu maanyi nti obugagga bwange obw’amaanyi bwava ku kumanya kwange n’okufuba kwange, so si mukisa okuva eri Allah.
Nalabulwa ku nguzi era ne banzijukiza okunoonya enkomerero n’ebyo Allah bye yali ampadde, naye ne ηηaana okuwuliriza ne ngenda mu maaso n’amalala.
Oluvannyuma Allah yandeetera ensi okunmira n’okubeera kwange, n’andeka nga sirina bayambi bawakanya kiragiro kye.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
